description.jei.wooden.door.2: Clicking on a door changes its state from open to closed and visa versa.
Clicking on a door changes its state from open to closed and vice versa.

notes: G13 is a small JSON semantic delta. The 101 unchanged key/value pairs may inherit exact G12 combined values. The re-added toggleEditMode key does not match its older G11 English meaning and therefore does not inherit an older translation. The two edit-mode description changes replace the literal %CTRL token with the runtime %s placeholder, so their G12 translations are never reused.
